skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develop a comprehensive understanding of web design principles and practices, including layout, typography, color theory, and user experience.
Create and manipulate HTML documents to structure web content.
Apply CSS to style and layout web pages, ensuring responsiveness and visual appeal.
Implement JavaScript to add interactivity and dynamic elements to web pages.
Develop and deploy fully functional web applications using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Design and implement responsive web layouts that adapt to various devices and screen sizes.
Understand and apply principles of user experience to enhance the usability and accessibility of web pages.
Apply problem-solving techniques to identify and resolve issues in web development projects.
Work effectively in teams to complete web design and development projects.
Manage and organize web development projects from conception to completion.
